nodes.description: DAOUpgradeableContract._authorizeUpgrade(address) restricts UUPS upgrade to the DAO avatar via _onlyAvatar().
UUPSUpgradeable.upgradeTo(address) external entrypoint, onlyProxy gated, calls _authorizeUpgrade then performs delegatecall upgrade.
GReputation.initialize(INameService,string,bytes32,uint256) initializer wiring roles, DAO name service and optional blockchain state hash.
GReputation._canMint() override allowing minters, GDAO_CLAIMERS, GDAO_STAKING and GDAO_STAKERS to mint reputation.
GReputation._mint(address,uint256) internal override that redirects to reputation recipient and updates delegate votes.
GReputation._burn(address,uint256) internal override that removes delegated votes on burn.
GReputation.setBlockchainStateHash(string,bytes32,uint256) public, _onlyAvatar gated, stores a cross-chain state hash.
GReputation._setBlockchainStateHash internal that pushes a BlockchainState and possibly mints rootState supply.
GReputation.delegateBySig allows delegation via EIP-712 signature, nonce and expiry checks.
GReputation._delegateTo(address,address) internal moves delegated votes between delegators.
GReputation._updateDelegateVotes writes checkpointed active votes for a delegate.
GReputation.checkProofOrdered verifies an unsorted merkle tree proof against a root.
GReputation.proveBalanceOfAtBlockchain verifies a merkle proof and stores the proven balance, minting on rootState.
GReputation.restoreState bulk restores state and balances, calling external GReputation for recipients and delegates.
GReputation.setReputationRecipient(address) lets msg.sender redirect earned reputation.
ERC1967UpgradeUpgradeable._functionDelegateCall performs a low-level delegatecall to a new implementation.
mapping(address => address) delegates tracking current delegate per user.
mapping(address => uint256[]) activeVotes checkpointed delegated vote totals.
mapping(address => address) reputationRecipients redirecting earned reputation.
mapping(address => uint256) nonces used for EIP-712 delegation signatures.
mapping(bytes32 => BlockchainState[]) blockchainStates storing per-chain state hashes.
mapping(bytes32 => mapping(address => uint256)) stateHashBalances proven balances per state hash.
bytes32[] activeBlockchains list of registered blockchain id hashes.
mapping(address => uint256[]) balances checkpointed reputation balances.
uint256[] totalSupplyHistory checkpointed total supply of reputation.
Controller public dao reference to the DAO controller contract.
address public avatar, the DAO avatar that owns and governs this contract.
INameService public nameService resolving DAO contract addresses.
msg.sender external caller used for role, avatar and minter checks.
block.timestamp used as signature expiry bound in delegateBySig.
Reputation.updateValueAtNow packs block.number with a 128-bit value shift and bounds check - arithmetic sensitive.
ecrecover based signature recovery for EIP-712 delegation authorization.
Low-level delegatecall to the new implementation inside UUPS upgrade flow.
External contract call to another GReputation instance while restoring state.
INameService _ns parameter used to resolve and set the DAO name service.
address _user parameter, the account reputation is minted to, burned from or proven for.
uint256 _amount parameter, quantity of reputation to mint or burn.
address _delegate parameter, the recipient of delegated votes.
bytes32[] _proof parameter, merkle proof elements verified in checkProofOrdered.
local delegator variable holding the effective delegate during mint/burn.
local previousVotes snapshot read before updating delegated votes.
local repTarget storing the reputation recipient address for a mint.
local signatory recovered from the EIP-712 delegation signature.
local idHash keccak256 of the blockchain string id used to index state.

edges.reason: upgradeTo calls _authorizeUpgrade before performing the upgrade, gating on avatar authorization.
upgradeTo routes through _functionDelegateCall to execute the new implementation.
delegatecall opcode is reached from _functionDelegateCall with an implementation address.
_onlyAvatar compares dao.avatar() against the stored avatar to authorize upgrades.
authorization depends on the untrusted msg.sender matching the DAO avatar.
initialize writes the resolved name service into nameService state.
the _ns parameter flows into setDAO and the name service assignment.
initialize calls _setBlockchainStateHash when an initial total supply is provided.
_canMint validates _msgSender() against minters and GDAO contract addresses.
_canMint resolves trusted minter addresses from nameService.
_mint reads reputationRecipients to determine the actual recipient of minted reputation.
repTarget local takes the recipient or falls back to _user.
_mint writes delegates[_user]=_user as the initial self delegation.
previousVotes local is read from getVotesAt before updating delegation.
_mint calls _updateDelegateVotes with increased vote totals.
mint path ultimately reaches updateValueAtNow which does the 128-bit value shift and bounds check.
the _user parameter is consumed by the mint logic.
the _amount parameter drives the reputation supply increase.
_burn reduces the checkpointed balance of the target account.
_burn normalizes the delegates mapping for the burning account.
previousVotes local is read before subtracting burned votes.
_burn calls _updateDelegateVotes with decreased vote totals.
burn path calls updateValueAtNow with a subtracted value that must stay within 128 bits.
setBlockchainStateHash is guarded by _onlyAvatar which reads the avatar state.
caller identity msg.sender must equal the DAO avatar to set a state hash.
public setter delegates the storage work to the internal implementation.
new blockchains are appended to the activeBlockchains array.
a new BlockchainState is pushed into blockchainStates for the id hash.
rootState updates totalSupplyHistory through updateValueAtNow.
idHash local is derived from the _id string and used as the state key.
setting rootState supply writes through the packed updateValueAtNow arithmetic.
delegateBySig consumes and increments the signer nonce for replay protection.
block.timestamp is compared against _expiry, a timestamp dependency for authorization.
the EIP-712 digest is passed to ecrecover to derive the signatory.
the recovered signatory local is used for nonce and delegation checks.
after signature validation delegation is applied through _delegateTo.
_delegateTo records the new delegate in the delegates mapping.
_delegateTo reads the delegator balance to know how many votes to move.
the _delegate parameter is validated and used as the vote recipient.
vote removal and addition are performed via _updateDelegateVotes calls.
moving votes performs add/subtract that feed the packed checkpoint arithmetic.
_updateDelegateVotes writes the new total into activeVotes checkpoints.
checkpointing active votes goes through the 128-bit shift arithmetic.
the _proof parameter elements are hashed while walking the merkle tree.
proveBalanceOfAtBlockchain reads the latest blockchain state for the given id.
stateHashBalances is written with the proven balance and checked to prevent double proofs.
the merkle proof is validated through checkProofOrdered before any state change.
a valid rootState proof triggers _mint of the proven balance.
rootState proof path calls updateValueAtNow to correct the total supply.
the _user parameter is hashed into the leaf and used as the mint recipient.
restoreState requires activeBlockchains to be empty, limiting it to one-time restoration.
restoreState registers the fuse state through _setBlockchainStateHash.
restoreState writes proven balances into stateHashBalances.
restoreState copies reputation recipients pulled from the external GReputation.
restoreState mints the supplied values via the internal _mint.
restoreState replays delegation through _delegateTo for each account.
restoreState performs external contract calls to another GReputation while updating balances, a potential reentrancy surface.
setReputationRecipient writes the caller chosen recipient into reputationRecipients.
the recipient mapping key is msg.sender, so a caller can only change its own record.

normalization_plan.reason: the _ns input parameter exists only to configure the name service inside initialize and carries no independent semantics.
the _user parameter is only meaningful as the mint/burn target handled by _mint and proof minting.
the _amount parameter directly feeds the mint arithmetic of _mint and should be folded into it.
the _delegate parameter is consumed only by _delegateTo for vote redirection.
the _proof array is only traversed inside checkProofOrdered and has no standalone meaning.
the delegator local is a temporary used solely to update delegate votes during _mint.
previousVotes is a transient snapshot feeding _updateDelegateVotes and should merge into that voting update.
repTarget is a short-lived alias for the resolved recipient inside _mint.
signatory exists only as the ecrecover result validated within delegateBySig.
idHash is a derived index computed and immediately used by _setBlockchainStateHash.
